question: Should OpenClaw make agent-scoped model-provider credential management a supported core gateway and Control UI contract, including scoped provider-run abortion on logout?
rationale: This is a new cross-client gateway API and user-facing fleet-management behavior; tests can validate mechanics but cannot determine the intended permanent credential-management and UI product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the core fleet contract
options.body: Approve the additive `agentId` protocol/UI direction after receiving two-agent runtime proof and explicit default-agent compatibility coverage.

options.title: Narrow to a lower-level seam
options.body: Keep generic agent-scoped credential primitives but defer or remove the Control UI and public RPC expansion until the supported operator workflow is defined.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the cross-agent credential-management contract if fleet auth administration is not intended for the current core product surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core fleet contract
recommendation.body: Approve the additive `agentId` protocol/UI direction after receiving two-agent runtime proof and explicit default-agent compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR history identifies steipete as the only evidenced contributor spanning the proposed gateway and UI contract.
